name: spatial/carousel-3d
title: 3D carousel
description: A ring of slides you rotate by key or button.

files.content:
export { Carousel3D } from './Carousel3D';
export type { Carousel3DProps, CarouselSlide } from './Carousel3D';

keyboard.action: With focus in the carousel, turn to the next slide.
With focus in the carousel, turn to the previous slide.
Move between the controls and into the current slide.
Use the focused control or picker dot.

notes: Follows the WAI-ARIA carousel pattern: a labelled region with `aria-roledescription="carousel"`, slides as groups with `aria-roledescription="slide"` and labels like “2 of 6: Fowey”.
Only the current slide can be reached; the others are `inert` and hidden from assistive technology.
Once you start turning it, slide changes are announced politely.
Picker dots have 24 px targets and names; the current one is marked with `aria-current`.
accessibility.reducedMotion: The ring jumps to the chosen slide without turning.
